title: Live Object Counter
tagline: Internship project for real-time counting on Jetson
intro: An internship project delivering a Python-based object counter optimized for NVIDIA Jetson.
summary: Combined OpenCV, Ultralytics, and Supervision to build a real-time edge-ready vision pipeline with annotations and counting. Completed in 2023-08.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Internship project to build a Jetson-optimized object counting and annotation pipeline with Python CV libraries.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a lightweight, real-time object counter running reliably on constrained Jetson hardware.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Developed pipeline with OpenCV + Ultralytics, integrated annotations with Supervision, optimized for edge deployment.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered a working CV tool during internship, proving feasibility of edge CV workloads on limited devices.
